rules.instruction: If an ordinance-or-law endorsement was in effect and received before an estimate was written but the estimate's 'Relied on' list omits it, sum the contractor's code upgrade items that appear in no estimate line. Report the sum, capped at the endorsement limit.
Compare the adjuster's written ALE promise (months and monthly rate) with the cutoff stated in the ALE notice. Unpaid ALE is (promised months - cutoff month) x monthly rate.
